requirements.statement: An employee can submit an expense claim with an amount, category, date, and description

criteria.must: An employee can submit a claim providing amount, category, date, and description
A submitted claim starts in submitted status

requirements.statement: A claim requires a receipt attachment before it can be submitted

criteria.must: Submitting a claim without a receipt attachment is rejected
A claim submitted with a receipt attachment succeeds

requirements.statement: An employee can see the status of every claim they've submitted

criteria.must: An employee's claims list shows each claim's status (pending, approved, or rejected)
An employee sees only their own claims in this list

requirements.statement: An employee can see their manager's comment when a claim is rejected

criteria.must: A rejected claim's detail view displays the manager's comment

requirements.statement: An employee can edit a rejected claim and resubmit it

criteria.must: An employee can edit the fields of a rejected claim
Resubmitting an edited claim returns it to submitted status

requirements.statement: A manager can see the pending claims submitted by the employees who report to them

criteria.must: A manager's pending-claims view lists only claims from their direct reports
A manager does not see claims from employees who do not report to them

requirements.statement: A manager can approve or reject a claim and leave a comment

criteria.must: A manager can approve a submitted claim from their direct report
A manager can reject a submitted claim from their direct report with a comment
A manager cannot approve or reject a claim from an employee who is not their direct report

requirements.statement: Finance can see all approved claims across the organization

criteria.must: A finance user's approved-claims view lists approved claims from every employee, not just their own team

requirements.statement: Finance can export approved claims for a given period to a downloadable file

criteria.must: Finance can request an export for a chosen date range
The exported file contains only claims approved within the chosen period
The exported file is downloadable in a payroll-consumable format such as CSV

requirements.statement: An exported claim is marked as exported so it is never exported twice

criteria.must: A claim included in one export is excluded from a subsequent export request

requirements.statement: An admin can assign or change each employee's manager

criteria.must: An admin can assign a manager to an employee who has none
An admin can change an employee's existing manager to a different one
Claims from an employee route to their currently assigned manager

requirements.statement: An admin can maintain the list of expense categories employees can choose from

criteria.must: An admin can add a new expense category
An admin can deactivate an existing expense category
An employee submitting a claim can only choose from active categories

requirements.statement: All users sign in through the platform's single sign-on identity provider

criteria.must: An unauthenticated visitor is redirected to sign in before reaching any claim data
